title: Among fossil fish in outback Queensland, a former curator spotted a slender bone from a Cretaceous bird unknown to science
description: A slender leg bone found near Richmond, Queensland, is the type of Tenuicruris piscanexum, only the second Cretaceous bird named from Australia.

title: Fossil signs Sawai Padmanabh Singh global ambassador for Signature collection
description: Fossil has announced Sawai Padmanabh Singh as the global ambassador for its Signature watch collection. The partnership was announced through a campaign filmed in Jaipur, with the collection unveiled at City Palace. The Signature line combines the brand’s American design heritage with Swiss watchmaking. Its debut collection, CS-1, takes inspiration from the American Case Study Houses program, known for its approach to mid-century design. Commenting on the partnership, Melissa Lowenkron, Chief Brand Officer, Fossil, said, “Signature introduces a new chapter of watchmaking for FOSSIL, bringing our American design heritage together with Swiss craftsmanship. Every detail reflects our commitment to purposeful, enduring design. His Highness Sawai Padmanabh Singh was a natural choice to represent the collection because he honours heritage while expressing it in a way that feels personal and contemporary.” The campaign film features Singh horseback riding, studying sundial blueprints and browsing his watch collection, with the timepieces incorporated into the scenes. The campaign carries the line, ‘As Distinct As Your Signature’. Speaking about the association, Sawai Padmanabh Singh said, “I have always appreciated products that honour heritage while remaining relevant to the present, and that is exactly what I found in the Signature Collection. FOSSIL has built a strong legacy around timeless design and craftsmanship, and Signature represents a bold new expression of that vision. Its thoughtful details and enduring style reflect the way I approach my own personal style. I am honoured to represent a collection that brings those values to life so authentically.” The Signature CS-1 collection marks Fossil’s return to Swiss watchmaking, building on more than two decades of the company’s presence in Switzerland. Johnson Verghese, Managing Director, Fossil India, said, “Signature represents a significant milestone for FOSSIL in India as we expand our presence in the premium watch category. Today’s Indian consumers are increasingly seeking enduring quality and meaningful design. With His Highness Sawai Padmanabh Singh as FOSSIL’s global ambassador, we are confident Signature will resonate strongly with consumers and play a key role in our growth journey."
